newsitem.title: USA: Jury selection in Newark bribery case.
newsitem.headline: Jury selection in Newark bribery case.

text.p: Jury selection began Tuesday in the federal bribery trial of Jackie Mattison, the chief of staff to Mayor Sharpe James, whose administration has been tainted by allegations of scandal.
Mattison was indicted last January on charges of accepting $17,000 in bribes to help his co-defendant, insurance broker William Bradley, win lucrative contracts with the city.
Mattison was accused of helping steer a no-bid contract to Great West Life & Annuity Insurance Co. to administer city employee retirement fund contracts.
Bradley was the insurance company's contact agent with Newark. Great West was cleared of any wrongdoing.
James' administration was the subject of several state and federal investigations. No charges were filed against James, who has been mayor of Newark since 1986.
